title: Maximum of Minimum Values in All Subarrays
goal: For every window length, maximize the minimum value among all windows.
strategy: A monotonic stack finds the widest span for which each value can be a minimum. Store that value at its span length, then propagate larger-window answers backward to fill missing lengths.
